drhp.business: Yogi Limited operates two segments: Real Estate (development, contracting and building, town planning and infrastructure development, and acquisition/development of immovable and movable properties) and Trading in Machinery (renting, leasing and trading of equipment, construction machinery, buildings, plots, vehicles, plants and other assets). During the year the Company made progress on its flagship Yogi Sea Project, described as a premium residential/commercial real estate development.
drhp.expansion: The Company is progressing its flagship Yogi Sea Project in the Real Estate segment, and expanded its business through acquisitions during FY2025-26: 100% stake in Yogi Homes Private Limited, an approximately 60% stake in Farewell Real Estate Private Limited (with a Rs. 45 Crore investment via subscription to Optionally Convertible Debentures), and a 95% stake in Yogi Realtors LLP effective 18th June 2025.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Fluctuations in equity and debt markets can impact investor sentiment, project funding, and overall business confidence.
- Variations in borrowing costs directly affect project viability, customer affordability, and profitability.
- Regulatory amendments relating to real estate, taxation, and capital markets may influence business operations and compliance requirements.
- Delays in collections, restricted access to credit, or mismatched cash flows can affect the Company's operational flexibility.
- Intense competition from established and emerging players in the real estate and allied segments could impact market share and margins.
- Global economic volatility, domestic market fluctuations, and evolving regulatory frameworks present ongoing uncertainties requiring continuous monitoring.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Focus on quality real estate developments with timely execution, customer satisfaction and value creation.
- Diversify revenue streams via the Trading in Machinery segment to reduce over-dependence on the real estate business and support risk management.
- Expand business operations and presence through acquisition of majority stakes in real estate and machinery entities.
- Leverage operational efficiencies and align strategies with market realities to safeguard competitive position.
